programs.title: Massive Engineering Mistakes
programs.desc: Every year, the world is filled with news about yet another failed or unsafe construction project.The series presents current and historical mishaps of engineers from around the world.

programs.title: Disruptive Nature
programs.desc: Presentation of the most severe natural disasters in the world, starting from 2000.The authors analyze the economic and emotional effects of earthquakes, avalanches, floods and hurricanes.

programs.title: Abandoned Engineering: Season 13
programs.desc: There are many engineering projects in the world that have been abandoned for various reasons.The creators of the program present the stories of these structures and the people who created them.Behind each of them there is a fascinating and unique story.Viewers will discover the most spectacular examples of abandoned buildings from around the globe, including an underground Nazi base in France, designed to attack London, and a secret Japanese facility.We will find out why they were created and what led to their fall.

programs.title: Tucci in Italy
programs.desc: Stanley Tucci will discover the Marche region.In Campania he will try long-forgotten grapes, in Veneto he will learn about the history of the tiramisu dispute, and in Sicily multicultural flavors await him.
